title: Enable U-VEND Manual Nos. with controlled before/after/reopen proof
purpose: Allow the planned first vendor number U-VEND-100 through the source-backed Manual Nos. field without creating the vendor in this case.

smartDecision.whyNow: First vendor creation is blocked by U-VEND numbering. The planned vendor number U-VEND-100 requires Manual Nos. according to Microsoft Learn and D2C mapped the technical field.
fieldsToChange: U-VEND Manual Nos. / Manuelle Anz. only
smartDecision.risk: Business Central list focus can drift; a wrong row checkbox would affect another number series.
smartDecision.fallback: Stop as blocked if U-VEND row and Manual Nos. cell cannot both be proven before write.
smartDecision.screenshotProof: Before/after/reopen screenshots must show U-VEND and Manual Nos. state; Page Inspection can support field identity but not replace reopen proof.
smartDecision.bookExplanation: Manual numbering lets a user type a readable vendor number such as U-VEND-100; automatic numbering would require Standardnr. instead.

entryCriteria: D2D result exists and selected Manual Nos. as next route.
Business Central context is playthru / UNIVERSAARL-DE.
D2E starts with read-only before proof of U-VEND row.
stopIf: The active instance is not playthru.
The active company is not UNIVERSAARL-DE.
U-VEND row is not uniquely visible.
Manual Nos. cell cannot be confidently mapped to U-VEND.
Any dialog asks to save unrelated setup, create a record, post, preview, delete or switch company.
The route would toggle Standardnr. or another number series.
acceptanceCriteria: Before screenshot shows U-VEND and current Manual Nos. state.
Only U-VEND Manual Nos. is changed if a safe row/field route exists.
Reopen proof shows U-VEND Manual Nos. active, or the case blocks without setup change.
No Preview Posting, Posting, payment, API shortcut or company switch occurs.

nextStepDecisionCard.lastEvidenceSummary: TARGET-036D2C proved U-VEND read-only on Number Series Page 456 and Page Inspection mapped Table 308 fields Default Nos. and Manual Nos.; it did not change setup or prove either checkbox active.
nextStepDecisionCard.reason: Vendor retry is still blocked because U-VEND numbering is unresolved. Since the planned first vendor number is U-VEND-100, Microsoft Learn supports Manual Nos. as the deliberate next numbering strategy; setup must be fitted before vendor creation.

lookaheadReviewed.reason: Smallest source-backed write: enable Manual Nos. only for U-VEND with before/after/reopen proof. No vendor is created in this case.
Retry becomes sensible only after U-VEND Manual Nos. is visibly active after reopen.
Item creation should wait until the vendor-numbering blocker is closed or explicitly parked.
Useful after numbering route closure to re-check foundation blockers before broader master data.

nextStepDecisionCard.whySelectedNextCaseIsBest: It resolves the specific first-vendor blocker with one narrow, source-backed setup field that matches the intended readable vendor number U-VEND-100, while keeping Standard Nos., master data, drafts, Preview and Posting locked.
risksBeforeNextCase: Do not toggle Standardnr. / Default Nos. in the manual-numbering case.
Do not create the vendor in D2E.
Do not change number-series lines or other number series.
Do not use row-menu screenshots as value proof without selected-row QA.
requiredPreparation: Use Page 456 U-VEND selected-row proof before write.
Use Liste bearbeiten or another explicit edit affordance only if the U-VEND row and Manual Nos. cell are both mapped.
Capture before, after and reopen screenshots plus Page Inspection/field context if needed.

blockedBy: U-VEND Manual Nos is not active after reopen proof.
warnings: The final route used a screenshot-QA coordinate fallback; the result is accepted only if the reopen proof shows U-VEND Manual Nos active.
resultSummary: U-VEND Manual Nos route was attempted, but Manual Nos was not active after reopen; no setup/masterdata/document/posting change accepted.
